about: The stock market: its rules, sectors, exchanges and listed companies. Built by build_companies.py from Eurostat (nama_10_a64, output P1, 2022, billions of euros) and a fixed seed; edit by hand freely. A company with "chain", "software" or "producer" is the game's own and keeps its own books; the rest run by formula. "share" is its share of its sector's output in its country, "cap" its market value at the start in euros, "margin" its margin before tax in a normal year, "debt" its net debt in years of profit.
